title: Ray Myers | Why AI Fails on Real Code (and How to Fix It)
description:
This is a teaser for Ray Myers' full session at AI Native DevCon Fall, November 18–19.

AI coding agents look magical in demos — until they hit real production code. Legacy systems, complex abstractions, sprawling dependencies, and years of context create failure modes LLMs aren’t ready for. The result? Hallucinated APIs, broken refactors, and lost trust.

In this preview, Ray Myers (Chief Architect, OpenHands) explains why AI struggles with mature codebases and what we can do to build agents that work in the real world — not just toy repos.

In the full DevCon talk, you will learn:
- Why LLMs break on legacy code — and what that tells us
- Practical patterns for making coding agents reliable in production
- How benchmarks like SWE-bench measure real progress
- Techniques for guiding AI in large, evolving codebases
- Emerging workflows for AI-assisted maintainability

Forget hype, this session is for teams shipping software that actually matters.

Speaker
Ray Myers — Chief Architect, OpenHands
18 years in software engineering. Legacy code specialist Co-host of Empathy in Tech and creator of Craft vs Cruft.
